title: Formal smoothness clause for a Cohen ring modulo a prime power
statement: Let p be prime and Λ a Cohen ring [def-weil-pbc-cohen-ring], namely a DVR with maximal ideal (p), complete for that ideal. For every n≥1 and every ZMod (p^n)-algebra structure on Λ/(p^n), the algebra Λ/(p^n) is formally smooth over ZMod (p^n).

proof.text: The maximal ideal is (p), so Λ/(p) is a field. Its p cast vanishes, hence it has characteristic p. For each ZMod p-algebra D and square-zero J, p vanishes in D. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-field-char-p-nilpotent-lifting] with N=2, and turn the ring-map lift into an algebra-map lift: any element of ZMod p is an integer cast. The iff_comp_surjective characterization gives the base case.

Induct on m to prove formal smoothness at exponent m+1. At zero use the base case; at the successor apply [lem-weil-pbc-cohen-ring-mod-pn-formally-smooth-step] to the previous formal smoothness result. Express n≥1 as n=1+m.
